additional_requirements: manic_episode is present for the majority of the total duration of the active and residual portions of the illness
delusions_and_hallucinations occur for 2 or more weeks in the absence of a major mood episode

S019.name: Delusions
S019.description: Fixed beliefs that do not change easily, even in the face of contradictory evidence.

subtypes.Persecutory Delusions: The false belief that one is being harmed or monitored by other people or organizations.
subtypes.Referential Delusions: The conviction that ordinary events, remarks, or behaviors have specific relevance to oneself.
subtypes.Grandiose Delusions: The false belief that one possesses special abilities, power, or fame.
subtypes.Erotomanic Delusions: The false belief that another person is in love with or has affection for them.
subtypes.Nihilistic Delusions: A destructive or negative conviction that the world is ending or that a major catastrophe will occur.
subtypes.Somatic Delusions: The baseless conviction that there is a serious abnormality with one's body or organs.
subtypes.Jealous Delusions: The conviction that one's spouse or romantic partner is being unfaithful without sufficient evidence.

S020.name: Hallucinations
S020.description: Perception-like experiences that occur without an external stimulus and are as vivid and clear as normal perception.

subtypes.Auditory Hallucinations: The perceptual experience of hearing voices or sounds when there is no actual sound.
subtypes.Visual Hallucinations: The perceptual experience of seeing people or objects that do not exist.
subtypes.Tactile Hallucinations: Experiencing the sensation of being touched or movement on the skin when there is no actual stimulus.
subtypes.Olfactory Hallucinations: The perceptual experience of smelling odors that do not exist.
subtypes.Gustatory Hallucinations: The perceptual experience of tasting flavors that are not actually present.

S022.name: Disorganized_Abnormal_Behavior
S022.description: A state where behavior and motor control are severely disturbed, appearing as movements or reactions inappropriate to the situation.

subtypes.Childlike Silliness: Inappropriate, childish, or illogical behavior appearing in situations.
subtypes.Stupor: No psychomotor activity; not actively relating to environment.
subtypes.Catalepsy: Passive induction of a posture held against gravity.
subtypes.Waxy Flexibility: Slight, even resistance to positioning by examiner.
subtypes.Mutism: No, or very little, verbal response despite the ability to speak.
subtypes.Negativism: Opposition or no response to instructions or external stimuli without apparent motive.
subtypes.Posturing: Spontaneous and active maintenance of a posture against gravity.
subtypes.Mannerism: Odd, circumstantial caricature of normal actions.
subtypes.Agitation: Excessive motor activity without obvious external cause.
subtypes.Grimacing: Contorted facial expressions irrelevant to the situation.

S023.name: Negative_Symptoms
S023.description: A state where emotions, motivation, speech, or social interest that should normally be present are diminished or lost.

subtypes.Diminished Emotional Expression: A state of reduced emotional expression in facial expressions, eye contact, intonation of speech, and movements.
subtypes.Avolition: A decrease in motivated self-initiated purposeful activities.
subtypes.Alogia: A state where the quantity of spontaneous speech is significantly reduced.
subtypes.Anhedonia: A decrease in the ability to experience pleasure or interest in enjoyable activities.
subtypes.Asociality: A state where interest in social activities or interpersonal relationships is significantly reduced.

S033.name: Elevated_Irritable_Mood
S033.description: A distinct period of abnormally and persistently elevated, expansive, or irritable mood.

subtypes.Elevated Mood: A mood that is abnormally high, euphoric, and full of unmotivated happiness and vitality.
subtypes.Irritable Mood: A state where one gets angry or aggressive even at minor stimuli.
subtypes.Mood Lability: Rapid shifts in mood, alternating unpredictably between euphoria and irritability.

S034.name: Increased_Activity
S034.description: Abnormally and persistently increased goal-directed activity or energy.

subtypes.Increased Energy: Overflowing physical and mental energy, leading to an inability to stay still and a desire to keep moving.
subtypes.Hyperactivity: Doing far more work than usual or starting multiple activities simultaneously.
subtypes.Psychomotor Agitation: Inability to tolerate resting or stopping, driven by a constant need to do something.

S035.name: Inflated_Self_Esteem
S035.description: Inflated self-esteem or grandiosity (may range from uncritical self-confidence to delusional proportions).

subtypes.Inflated Self-Confidence: Feeling capable of anything and believing that failure is impossible, unlike one's usual self.
subtypes.Overestimation of Abilities: Unrealistically assessing one's talents, knowledge, or abilities as superior.
subtypes.Grandiose Delusions: The false belief that one is a special and important person with a special mission or purpose.

S036.name: Decreased_Sleep
S036.description: Decreased need for sleep (e.g., feels rested after only 3 hours of sleep).

subtypes.Reduced Sleep Duration: Sleeping significantly less than usual but feeling refreshed rather than tired.
subtypes.Loss of Sleep Need: Not feeling the urge to sleep or the thought that sleep is necessary.
subtypes.Indifference to Insomnia: Feeling no problem and continuing activities despite staying up for several nights.

S038.name: Racing_Thoughts
S038.description: Flight of ideas or subjective experience that thoughts are racing.

subtypes.Racing Thoughts: Thoughts spinning too fast in the head, constantly jumping from one idea to another.
subtypes.Flooding of Thoughts: Too many thoughts emerging simultaneously, making them disorganized.
subtypes.Inability to Control Thoughts: Unable to stop or slow down thoughts and unable to calm the mind.

S039.name: Manic_Distractibility
S039.description: Attention is too easily drawn to unimportant or irrelevant external stimuli.

subtypes.Responsiveness to Extraneous Stimuli: Attention is immediately drawn to trivial and unimportant stimuli nearby (e.g., noise, movement).
subtypes.Frequent Task Switching: Unable to finish one task and constantly shifting attention to new things, starting multiple tasks simultaneously.
subtypes.Inability to Sustain Attention: Unable to focus on any activity for long, with attention constantly being scattered.

info.persona: Matthew Souther, a 41‑year‑old routine‑oriented caretaker, blends disciplined organization with outgoing community spirit, savoring Southern BBQ while meticulously planning every detail from care schedules to hunting trips.
info.professional_persona: Matthew Souther, a 41‑year‑old personal care aide from rural East Tennessee, blends meticulous routine‑driven care with a warm, talkative bedside manner, excelling at ADL assistance, wound monitoring, documentation, and mentoring new aides while routinely volunteering to lead safety briefings and health workshops at his senior center.
info.cultural_background: Matthew was born and raised in Hancock County, a rural part of East Tennessee that is steeped in Appalachian tradition. His family’s heritage traces back to early English and Scotch‑Irish settlers, and he grew up in a close‑knit community where church, family, and local gatherings formed the core of daily life. He identifies with Southern Baptist values, attending a local congregation where faith, hospitality, and service to neighbors are emphasized. The region’s cultural fabric, marked by folk music, storytelling, and a strong work ethic, shaped his practical outlook and appreciation for routine. He cherishes longstanding customs such as community potlucks, Fourth of July fireworks, and seasonal festivals that celebrate the area's agricultural roots. This background fosters his respect for elders, dedication to community service, and belief in self‑reliance balanced with collective support.
info.hobbies_and_interests: Outside of work, Matthew thrives on social and hands‑on activities that reinforce his love for routine and community. He regularly volunteers at the local senior center, organizing weekly game nights and leading a walking group for seniors. He is an avid participant in the town’s country‑music line‑dancing club and enjoys attending high‑school football games, where he frequently chats with fellow fans. In his spare time he maintains a modest vegetable garden, practices woodworking by building furniture for family and friends, and spends weekends hunting and fishing in the nearby Appalachian foothills. Matthew also enjoys cooking traditional Southern meals, especially barbecue, and often hosts family barbecues. He is a member of his church’s men’s fellowship, where he helps plan community service projects and occasionally delivers short talks on health and wellness.
info.sports_persona: Matthew Souther, a 41‑year‑old sports enthusiast, roots for the Tennessee Titans and the UT Volunteers football team, attends every local high‑school Friday night game, is a member of the Appalachian Sportsmen’s Club where he hunts deer and trout during the season, and spends Sunday mornings doing light softball with the church men’s fellowship league.
info.arts_persona: Matthew Souther, a 41‑year‑old cultural participant, enjoys line‑dancing to country classics by Dolly Parton, George Strait, and the Charlie Daniels Band at the town’s weekly dance nights, volunteers as a backstage assistant for community theater productions of classic Southern dramas, and collects vinyl records of Alabama and Brad Paisley to play during family barbecues.
info.travel_persona: Matthew Souther, a 41‑year‑old traveler, favors road trips in his trusty pickup to the Great Smoky Mountains for weekend hikes, makes annual family pilgrimages to Nashville’s music venues to see live country shows, dreams of a guided hunting expedition in the Texas Hill Country, and occasionally winds down with a relaxing beach stay in Gulf Coast Alabama after a busy harvest season.
info.culinary_persona: Matthew Souther, a 41‑year‑old home chef, prides himself on mastering hickory‑smoked pork shoulder ribs, jalapeño‑cheddar corn bread, collard greens simmered with smoked turkey, and sweet tea sweetened with a splash of local honey, regularly grills for his community potlucks, and balances his love of rich Southern fare with fresh garden harvests of tomatoes, beans, and zucchini.

info.persona: Antionette Givens blends a competitive, skeptical edge with gentle curiosity, turning daily caregiving into a canvas for art, crochet, and garden experiments, even if they sometimes hoard stray paint tubes and skip bedtime in pursuit of the next creative spark.
info.professional_persona: Antionette Givens, a 55‑year‑old personal care aide with three decades of hands‑on experience, leverages meticulous documentation, empathetic listening, and a competitive drive to excel in client safety while secretly channeling curiosity into crafting art‑based enrichment sessions for seniors, a step toward their goal of becoming a CNA supervisor and care coordinator.
info.cultural_background: Antionette grew up in the Black community of the Upstate of South Carolina, where church gatherings, gospel music, and family storytelling shaped her identity. The legacy of resilience and communal support among African‑American families in the region informs her caring philosophy and her commitment to honoring clients' cultural preferences. She draws on the rich culinary traditions of Southern soul food, often adapting recipes to meet health needs while preserving flavor. Her appreciation for the arts is informed by the vibrant local movements that celebrate Black creativity, from mural projects in Greenville to community theater. Antionette's cultural heritage also instilled a strong work ethic and a sense of responsibility toward uplifting others, which she expresses through mentorship and volunteer work at community centers.
info.hobbies_and_interests: In her free time, Antionette enjoys watercolor painting, especially scenes inspired by the Upstate South Carolina landscape, and she frequently visits local galleries and community art workshops. She finds solace in gardening, tending to a modest vegetable patch where she experiments with heirloom varieties. She also practices crochet, creating blankets and accessories for clients and charitable donations. Antionette is an avid reader of art history and African‑American literature, and she attends small‑group book discussions at the local library. Occasionally, she explores new culinary recipes, focusing on soul‑food traditions with a health‑conscious twist. Her love for music includes listening to jazz, gospel, and contemporary R&B while walking the trails at nearby Falls Park.
info.sports_persona: Antionette Givens enjoys low‑impact morning walks along Falls Park trails with the local Greenville Strollers walking club and follows the Greenville Drive baseball team and the Carolina Panthers with an analytical eye, while occasionally playing in a senior recreation softball league each spring, balancing their competitive nature with a reserved preference for solitary exercise.
info.arts_persona: Antionette Givens spends afternoons in her studio reproducing Upstate South Carolina vistas in watercolor, drawing inspiration from the luminous palettes of Winslow Homer and the contemplative brushwork of Andrew Wyeth, while listening to John Coltrane’s saxophone improvisations, Mahalia Jackson’s gospel hymns, and Beyoncé’s soulful R&B to fuel both her painting and crochet sessions.
info.travel_persona: Antionette Givens prefers meticulously planned weekend getaways to historic Southern towns such as Charleston and Savannah, combined with occasional pilgrimages to European art capitals like Florence and the Mediterranean island of Santorini, traveling with small, like‑minded groups to balance cultural enrichment and restful downtime.
info.culinary_persona: Antionette Givens, an intermediate home chef, masterfully reimagines classic Southern comfort dishes such as baked catfish with a quinoa‑kale slaw, sweet potato pie sweetened with honey, and collard greens seasoned with smoked paprika and fresh heirloom tomatoes, while also delighting in farm‑to‑table markets for the freshest produce to fuel her artistic spirit.

info.persona: Andres Serrano is a meticulous, sociable elder who blends practical craftsmanship with competitive spirit, savoring garden‑grown flavors, rhythmic beats, and community stories while they occasionally let skepticism guard their generous heart.
info.professional_persona: A seasoned community handyman like Andres Serrano leverages decades of carpentry, electrical, and plumbing expertise to methodically plan and execute neighborhood improvement projects, while they channel a charismatic presence and organized precision to become the go‑to facilitator for local events and volunteer coordination.
info.cultural_background: Andres Serrano is a lifelong resident of Las Piedras, a small municipality in the southeastern region of Puerto Rico. Born in 1941 into a working‑class family, he grew up during the island’s post‑World War II industrialization, witnessing the shift from agriculture to manufacturing while his parents maintained a modest farm. His upbringing was steeped in Puerto Rican Catholic traditions, with family gatherings centered around shared meals, music, and folklore. He speaks Spanish as his first language and learned to understand regional idioms and sayings unique to the southeastern coast. The cultural rhythms of bomba and plena, the annual patron saint festival, and the communal practice of preparing pasteles during holidays have shaped his identity. His Puerto Rican heritage also instills a strong sense of community solidarity, which he expresses through his involvement in local associations and his dedication to preserving the island’s oral histories for future generations.
info.hobbies_and_interests: Andres spends his free time tending to his garden, where he grows tomatoes, plantains, and herbs that he uses in his cooking. He loves preparing family meals and experimenting with new twists on classic Puerto Rican recipes. Music is a constant companion; he listens to bomba, plena, salsa, and boleros, and occasionally joins a local music group as a percussionist. He is an avid chess and dominoes player, frequently meeting friends at the community center for spirited matches. Weekly, he attends mass at the local Catholic church and participates in its choir. He also enjoys strolling through Las Piedras’ streets, reminiscing about the town’s history, and volunteering as a storyteller at the municipal cultural program, sharing anecdotes with school children.
info.sports_persona: A devoted fitness enthusiast like Andres Serrano walks daily through the town’s historic streets, follows the local baseball team Los Leones de Las Piedras, participates in the Senior Strollers Club’s low‑impact fitness walks, and competes in local seniors’ chess and domino tournaments, while they balance their competitive edge with a methodical routine.
info.arts_persona: A rhythmic storyteller like Andres Serrano fills evenings with bomba, plena, salsa and boleros, drums with the community ensemble Los Tambores del Pueblo, sings baritone in the church choir, and shares vivid tales of local legend to schoolchildren, letting music and narrative shape their vibrant social presence and they cherish the lively exchange in each story.
info.travel_persona: A methodical traveler like Andres Serrano plans relaxed day trips to historic plazas, revisits the colonial cathedral in Old San Juan, and dreams of exploring the colorful streets of Cartagena and the architectural marvels of Barcelona, arranging each itinerary with the same meticulous garden‑planning mindset they apply to their vegetable patches.
info.culinary_persona: A culinary innovator like Andres Serrano masterfully prepares arroz con gandules, pasteles, and lechón, infusing them with garden‑fresh herbs such as cilantro and oregano while experimenting with subtle twists like plantain‑based garnish, showcasing their deep respect for tradition and curious palate, and they constantly seek new flavor pairings.
